violation_type.title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Supervised Naptimes or Rest Times (26 TAC §744.2002(7))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Supervised Naptimes or Rest Times
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation's activity plan did not include a rest period for the children. Noted: this was corrected during this inspection when the activity plan was updated to include a rest period.
